{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue_clean == 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Also confirm the number of refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders in cleaned data: {len(df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'refunded'])}")

# Check the distribution of channels and segments
df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size()"}
